label: Eaton ePDU G3 Managed 3-phase 0U 8.64kW (21xC13 6xC19 1x5-20R)
description: Three-phase 0U managed rack PDU: NEMA L21-30P input, 120/208 V, 24 A, 8.64 kW, feeding 21 C13, 6 C19 and one 5-20R outlet with per-outlet switching and metering. The embedded eNMC module presents a single 10/100BASE-T RJ45 for the Web UI, CLI/Telnet, SNMP and DHCP-based addressing, plus an RS-232 port that also accepts an Environmental Monitoring Probe.
notes: SKU page gives the electrical/outlet data (3PH, 0U, L21-30P, 8.64 kW, 24 A, 120/208 V, 28 outlets = 21 C13 + 6 C19 + 1 5-20R, RS-232 serial interface). Port speed comes from the ePDU G3 installation and connectivity quick start (P-164000314): item 4 is an 'Ethernet 10/100 Base-T Port' with a green LED that is OFF at 10 Mbit/s and ON at 100 Mbit/s, and the network connection 'automatically receives an IP address through DHCP'. The daisy-chain port (up to four ePDUs sharing one Ethernet port through an RJ-45 splitter) is a proprietary PDU bus, not an Ethernet segment, so it is not modelled.
